location_exception_reason: GI portable cabins are standardised prefabricated structures sold nationwide; location of manufacture or deployment does not alter the product's functional specification or buyer decision-making. No GI designation is location-dependent (unlike GI-tagged agricultural products).
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'GI Portable Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product definition complete and unchanged.
